scenes.title: Rai and the Awakened Soul
scenes.rationale: One continuous camp conversation establishes Kenzo’s personal stakes and the party’s plan for the monastery.
scenes.overview: Kenzo shares his visions and suspicions about Rai; the party plans its investigation.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party leaves camp and approaches the monastery along the dry river.

scenes.title: Scouting the Monastery
scenes.rationale: The riverbed approach and reconnaissance reveal the lair and end with the party regrouping before deciding whether to attack.
scenes.overview: The party reaches the monastery and discovers two adult manticores and two young.
scenes.transitionToNext: After regrouping, the party decides how to deal with the manticores.

scenes.title: The Manticore Ambush
scenes.rationale: The decision to attack, driftglobe diversion, fight, and nest search form a complete encounter after reconnaissance.
scenes.overview: The party plans a driftglobe diversion, kills the manticores, and finds gnoll remains.
scenes.transitionToNext: The noisy fight draws six orcs out of the bathhouse.

scenes.title: Grash’s Watchers
scenes.rationale: The investigating patrol creates a new confrontation that continues through capture, interrogation, and confinement.
scenes.overview: Enlarged Kenzo helps defeat the patrol; its captive captain reveals the watch’s purpose and warns of tower ghosts.
scenes.transitionToNext: With the captain confined, the party returns to Bhishma’s sealed doors.

scenes.title: Behind Bhishma’s Sacred Doors
scenes.rationale: The full party opens the sacred doors and explores together until Wellby and Delwath decide to turn back.
scenes.overview: Prayer opens the doors; the party collects holy water and encounters Bhishma’s living story.
scenes.transitionToNext: Wellby and Delwath turn back, leaving Kenzo and Seeker to follow the initiation.

scenes.title: The Mysteries of Bhishma
scenes.rationale: At the user’s direction, the whole sequence from Wellby and Delwath turning back through Kenzo’s initiation, revival, new sight, and final prayer remains one scene.
scenes.overview: Kenzo and Seeker follow Bhishma’s story; Kenzo dies and returns, then receives the message about Shakun’s heart.
